_doc: Step 11 §3.4: what a listener may notice when someone is nervous saying something (a lie, or a nervous truth). Never says 'lying'. {name} = the speaker, {poss} = their his/her/their.
cues: {name} smiles, but only with the mouth.
{name} glances at the door as {subj} says it.
{name} gives more detail than you asked for.
{name}'s voice goes a shade too even.
{name} looks at you a moment too long, as if to see whether you believe it.
